title: Sidecarless observability architecture - air-gapped & VPC playbook (draft)
content:
Purpose and scope:

This is a working draft exploring a "sidecarless" observability pattern for private deployments (VPC and air-gapped on-prem). Goal: reduce per-pod resource overhead, simplify upgrades in constrained environments, and make Terraform module composition clearer for customers who cannot run sidecars (security or distro limits).

This doc covers:
- high-level architecture proposal
- concrete terraform module notes and inputs/outputs we should expose
- upgrade and rollout plan for Prometheus/Grafana and OTEL collectors in private envs
- log-shipping considerations and lightweight host agents
- testing/backout checklist and open questions

Quick summary of the approach:
- Move from per-pod sidecars to a small set of dedicated telemetry collectors per node-pool / availability zone (collector gateway pattern).
- Use OTEL Collector in agent-mode on nodes (but configured to forward to a local gateway in the VPC). For air-gapped installs the gateway writes to S3-compatible storage or to on-prem object store which batch-uploads to central ingest.
- Prometheus runs as a StatefulSet per customer cluster; scraping is done by a combination of: node-level prometheus scrape exporters, kube-state-metrics, and central gateway push/remote_write where needed.
- Grafana runs as a read-only instance with a central read-replica model (read-only dashboards pulled via snapshot sync).
- Log shipping: lightweight fluent-bit on host that forwards to collector gateway or directly to customer's log sink (e.g. internal Kafka/Graylog).

Constraints / non-goals:
- We assume customers will want minimal host modifications (no kernel patches).
- Not attempting to replace service-level sidecars for tracing headers; we will provide SDK helpers and a tracing injection guide instead.
- Does not cover long-term storage backend choices in depth (we sketch S3-compatible or on-prem object stores).

Architecture details:

1) Telemetry topology
- Host agent (DaemonSet) running OTEL Collector in agent mode (low-memory build) - collects logs via fluent-bit or collector receiver, metrics via node_exporter, and traces via otlp receiver from instrumented apps (if available).
- Gateway Collector (Deployment/StatefulSet with PVCs) runs in a dedicated observability namespace; accepts telemetry from agents and applies batching, sampling, transformation, then forwards to either: remote_write endpoint (for hosted Redwood ingest), or to local storage/buffer (minio) for air-gapped sync.
- Prometheus per-cluster scrapers for Kubernetes API, kube-state-metrics, and node_exporter; remote_write configured to forward aggregated samples to central TSDB (for cross-cluster queries) OR keep local storage if customer requires data to stay on-prem.
- Grafana: local, lightweight instance for interactive debugging; if central dashboards are required we provide a sync job to export/import dashboards from the central Grafana repo.

2) Security and networking
- Use mTLS between agents and gateway via certs issued from customer KMS/HSM or our PKI for managed private deploys.
- Gateway sits in a dedicated VPC subnet with strict NSGs. Agents talk only to gateway IP/hostname.
- For air-gapped deployments, use signed artifact bundles for OTEL configs and modules delivered via customer-approved channels.

Terraform module notes (initial sketch)

We should provide 3 composable modules:
- observability-networking (subnets, security groups, route tables, NAT/egress endpoints)
- observability-collector (DaemonSet + gateway + config artifacts + cert bootstrap)
- prometheus-grafana (operator + StatefulSets + remote_write / read-replica glue)

Inputs (examples) - expose these as module variables:
- environment (string)
- cluster_name (string)
- prometheus_retention_days (number)
- prometheus_remote_write_endpoint (string/null)
- gateway_replicas (number)
- agent_resources (map string -> string) - CPU/memory presets (note: keep as string for easier HCL rendering)
- artifact_bucket (string) - for airgap bundles
- tls_cert_secret (string) - name of Kubernetes secret storing agent certs

Outputs (examples) - expose these as module outputs:
- gateway_service_dns (string)
- prometheus_endpoint (string)
- grafana_endpoint (string)
- artifacts_uploaded (bool) - (string "true"/"false" for HCL compatibility)

State and deployment model notes:
- Each module creates resources in a single Terraform workspace per customer cluster (workspace naming: obs-{env}-{cluster}). Avoid mixing clusters in a single state.
- Remote state backend: recommend S3 with server-side encryption for dedicated environments; for air-gapped provide instructions to use local filesystem + object store snapshots.

Upgrade and rollout plan (prometheus / grafana / collectors)

Guiding principles:
- Prefer rolling upgrades with small blast radius (1/3 of replicas)
- Automated DB migrations for Prometheus should be avoided during upgrade windows; prefer side-by-side spin-up of new StatefulSet and switch Service selector when stable (zero-downtime pattern).

Prometheus (operator-managed) upgrade steps (high level):
1) Backup: snapshot local TSDB (promtool snapshot) -> upload to object store (minio).
2) Create new Prometheus StatefulSet with next minor version image and a new PVC template (size+labels). Start with replica=1 to warm caches.
3) Once ready, scale to target replicas one at a time, validate scrapes and remote_write.
4) Switch Service selector to new StatefulSet and wait 5m for traffic stabilization.
5) Decommission old StatefulSet after validating remote_read/long-term queries.

OTEL Collector gateway upgrade steps:
- Because gateway holds buffers, perform rolling restart with preStop hook that flushes queues. Validate that agents can reconnect and that throughput is within acceptable bounds. Keep at least 2 gateway replicas for HA.

Agent DaemonSet upgrade notes:
- Use maxUnavailable: 1 per zone. Ensure host-based logs are buffered locally (filesystem) so temporary disconnects won't drop data.

Grafana upgrade steps:
- Use read-only flag during upgrade. Export dashboards; run upgrade on a replica, validate plugins and datasources, then promote. For air-gapped plugin installs use pre-baked plugin bundles.

Log shipping specifics:
- Host-level fluent-bit with small memory footprint, persistent spool on host (configurable path) to handle gateway outages.
- Logs can be labeled and routed at agent using relay rules (e.g., app=payments -> kafka-topic payments).

Smoke tests and verification:
- Post-deploy checks (script):
  - curl ${gateway_service_dns}/healthz -> 200
  - verify agent count: kubectl get ds -n observability | grep agents -> desired==current
  - prometheus targets healthy: prometheus/api/v1/targets -> all up
  - grafana health endpoint and dashboard list available

Terraform test notes:
- Provide example terragrunt overlays for customers. Include a local test harness that deploys minio + gateway + agent to a small k3s cluster for CI.

Air-gap specifics:
- Deliver module + artifacts tarball: terraform modules, helm charts, container images (OCI tarballs), certificates, and a manifest file describing versions.
- Bootstrapping: upload tarball to customer's artifact_bucket. Run `apply` which will create PVCs and cronjob that syncs tarball contents to pods.

Open questions / risks / TODOs:
- How to handle trace context propagation if we remove sidecars? (we need to publish SDK guidance and auto-instrumentation best-effort).
- Sampling policy: where to enforce (agent or gateway)? We prefer gateway for global control but that increases CPU there.
- Runtime memory budgets: establish realistic default agent_resources for small/medium/large node types. (Priya to run memory matrix tests)
- Backpressure behavior between gateway and remote_write endpoints: need a rejection/backoff strategy documented.

Action items / next steps:
- Prototype collector gateway config and memory profile (owner: Ethan) - due 2025-02-28
- Terraform module initial PR with observability-networking + collector (owner: Aisha) - draft due 2025-03-07
- Prepare air-gap artifact manifest format (owner: Luca) - draft due 2025-03-10

Notes to self: keep this doc terse and move long config snippets into a separate snippets file (obs-sidecarless-configs.md). Also: add a small diagram (ascii) later showing flow agent -> gateway -> remote_write/minio.

References and helpful links:
- Confluence: "Sidecarless Approach" (linked above)
- GH: terraform-modules PR #412 (linked above)
- JIRA: JIRA-OBS-789 - "Airgap packaging for observability"

End of draft.
